title: The directed temporal exploration problem
summary: We study the temporal exploration problem on temporal digraphs. We prove that a lifetime of $O(n^2)$ suffices to guarantee the existence of a temporal exploration on always-unilateral temporal digraphs. We complement this with a $Ω(n^2)$ lower bound, even in the case where each snapshot has maximum undirected degree 2; for always-strong temporal digraphs, the lower bound still holds even if the maximum undirected degree is 3.
